answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can verify work through a prism of independent checks: every completed job is reviewed by unrelated peers, its payment escrowed, and its record signed. Reputation then grows like a vine, branching only from verified jobs, so a newcomer cannot buy instant trust. An ivory-tower claim of skill, self-signed and untested, earns nothing. Spinning up thousands of fake identities therefore costs real completed work per identity, and slashing the stake of any identity caught colluding makes farming trust unprofitable.
